description: Local Markets: markets away from big cities. Every recorded market place in the world tagged by how far it sits from cities (Natural Earth): big_city (<=30 km of a 1M+ city), city (<=30 km of a 100k+ city), regional (30-100 km), remote (>100 km). Default answers return only regional and remote markets, the village and rural markets big catalogues bury. Places: Overture Maps Foundation (CDLA-Permissive-2.0). Cities: Natural Earth (public domain). Locality computed by Lilambd. Routes: /near (lat*, lon*, radius_km, locality, limit, offset); /{id}; /search (q*, locality, limit); /country (country*, locality, limit, offset); /countries. Paid $0.05 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /near, /{id}, /search, /country, /countries. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.

name: local-markets
